entities.name: Query Nnr protein
observations: 468 aa; estimated molecular weight 49.71 kDa; theoretical pI 5.95; predicted net charge at pH 7 is -5.63.
Strong homology to reviewed bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes: 38.7–40.0% identity over 98.3–98.9% query coverage, E-values 3.27e-103 to 1.36e-89.
Pfam architecture: YjeF_N PF03853 at residues 1–158 and Carb_kinase PF01256 at residues 217–455.
No signal peptide or transmembrane segment is indicated by the sequence report; localization is therefore most consistent with a soluble intracellular enzyme, but this is inferential.
Evidence grade is moderate homology support; exact substrate specificity and organism-specific regulation are not experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: Bifunctional Nnr
observations: Reviewed homologs Q83CM5, P31806, and Q9KMX5 are annotated as bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes.
The N-terminal YjeF-like module supports NAD(P)HX epimerase activity; the C-terminal module supports ADP-dependent dehydration of (S)-NAD(P)HX.
Annotated reactions include (6R)-NAD(P)HX epimerization to (6S)-NAD(P)HX and ADP-dependent dehydration of (6S)-NAD(P)HX to regenerate NAD(P)H, producing AMP and phosphate.
Reviewed homologs bind one K+ ion per subunit; corresponding EC numbers are 5.1.99.6 and 4.2.1.136.
Associated GO terms include NAD(P)HX epimerase activity, ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity, metabolite repair, and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.

entities.name: NAD(P)H metabolite repair
observations: Nnr repairs enzymatically or heat-generated NAD(P)H hydrates (NAD(P)HX), preventing accumulation of damaged nicotinamide nucleotides and reconnecting them to central redox metabolism.
